notes.title: Layouts and Tags Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42074758/2a55b4d250c5b74a10959baffa1b9aa1b77fda13.png[/img][h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
- Added lobby queue information
- Added tags to platforms and players
- Added Ids to platforms
- Trigger targets can use id/tags to filter recipients
- Added new trigger conditions:
[list]
- Player With Tag 
- Player Without Tag 
- On Platform With Id 
- On Platform With Tag 
- No Player With Tag 
- No Platform With Id 
- No Platform With Tag
[/list]
- Added new/changed events
[list]
- Added "Tag Event" for players 
- Added "Win Event" for players
- Added "Eliminate Event" for players
- Added "Tag Event" for platforms
- Added pivot to rotation and spin event
[/list]
- Added advanced inspector option to show Tags and IDs
- Platforms can be spawned from triggers without using events
- New layout menu can be used to spawn platforms before the game starts
- Added info box at the start of games. Allows a more detailed description/tutorial for how the game works.
- Added save indicator to more places in the game mode UI and in main menu
- Game modes can be saved with Ctrl+S
- Player transparency can be enabled in the lobby
[/list]
[i]Bugfixes[/i]
[list]
Players can no longer get stuck under rotating lobby platform
Time bomb timer no longer displays milliseconds
Tournament no longer causes players to disconnect if they join after the tournament starts
[/list]

notes.title: The Season Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42074758/e4bf5c601244296ff917d1506de8a0fb72b90935.png[/img]
[h1]The game will become free to play![/h1]
Party Bots will be free to play [b]very soon[/b] so if you are thinking of buying it then wait! The reason for this change is that we want to make Party Bots more accessible for everyone. This also means that we have added cosmetics that you can buy in-game!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added Seasons and Season Pass
[*]Added a in-game shop
[*]New customization: Body
[*]New customization: Trail
[*]New special colors to obtain
[*]Added a whole new basement area
[*]Added three lobby games
[*]New currency: Party Emeralds
[*]Coin bundles can sometimes spawn (Official lobbies only)
[*]Party emeralds can sometimes spawn (Official lobbies only)
[*]Added bonus games with extra rewards (Official lobbies only)
[*]Added 41 Steam Achievements
[*]Ability to view all items in-game, even those you don't own
[*]Tournament UI is available for the players
[*]Added two new gamemode events:
[list]
[*]Player Health
[*]Player Max Health
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42074758/7cc2a368e031fe5388b6e15152ea521cf4e50096.png[/img]

tags.feature: [*]Coin bundles can sometimes spawn (Official lobbies only)
[*]Party emeralds can sometimes spawn (Official lobbies only)
[*]Added bonus games with extra rewards (Official lobbies only)
[*]Ability to view all items in-game, even those you don't own
[*]Tournament UI is available for the players

notes.title: Winter Event!
notes.content:
The Winter Event [b]starts now[/b] and will run [b]until the end of January[/b]!

Collect Candy Canes and buy Presents to get winter related items for your bot!

We have added 22 new winter items to the game and the only way to get them is by collecting Candy Canes!

[h3]There is 3 ways to get Candy Canes![/h3]
[list]
[*]Playing the game will grant you random amount of Candy Canes every hour, twelve hours a day
[*]Getting close or winning a game in an official lobby will get you Candy Canes, the amount depends on how many people are in the game
[*]Random Candy Canes will spawn in the arena and also in the lobby on official servers
[/list]


So what are you waiting for, get those Candy Canes and collect winter items!

tags.feature: We have added 22 new winter items to the game and the only way to get them is by collecting Candy Canes!

notes.title: Summer Event!
notes.content:
This event starts now and will run throughout the summer! (Yes, we know this is a bit late, but we can stretch summer a bit)

[b]Collect Ice creams and buy cooler boxes to get summer related items for you bot![/b]

We have added 20 new summer items to the game and the only way to get them is by collecting ice creams!

[b]There is 3 ways to get ice creams![/b]
[list]
[*] Playing the game will grant you random amount of ice creams every hour, twelve hours a day
[*] Getting close or winning a game on an official lobby will get you ice creams, the amount depends on how many people are in the game
[*] Random ice creams will spawn in the arena and also in the lobby on official servers
[/list]

So what are you waiting for!
